title: Fix Grasshopper Missing Icon Resources
description: The code is outdated after folder structure changes; resource lookups like attributediff_24x24 fail. Refactor icon/resource resolution to new paths and use placeholders for missing assets.
summary: Fixed NullReferenceException in ProcessModel for KitComponent, TypeComponent, and DesignComponent by using null-conditional operator ?.Replace() instead of .Replace() on Icon, Image, and Preview fields that can be null.
